'''Miranda May Kerr''' ({{IPAc-en|k|ɜr}}; born 20 April 1983) is an Australian model. She rose to prominence in 2007 as one of the [[Victoria's Secret]] Angels. Kerr was the first Australian Victoria's Secret model and also represented the Australian department store chain [[David Jones (department store)|David Jones]]. She has launched her own brand of organic skincare products, [[KORA Organics]], and has written a [[self-help book]].

Kerr began modelling in the fashion industry when she was only 13, winning the 1997 ''[[Dolly (magazine)|Dolly]]'' magazine model search competition. Since 2008, she has consistently ranked on the ''[[Forbes]]'' list of [[Forbes list of the world's highest-paid models|highest earning models]]. She was previously married to English actor [[Orlando Bloom]], with whom she had her first son. Since 2017, she has been married to [[Snapchat]] CEO [[Evan Spiegel]], with whom she has three children.

==Early life==
Kerr was born in [[Sydney]] and raised in [[Gunnedah]].<ref name=BOF>{{cite web|url=https://www.businessoffashion.com/community/people/miranda-kerr|title=Miranda Kerr|work=Business of Fashion|date=5 September 2019 }}</ref> She is the daughter of Therese and John Kerr. Her mother gave birth to her when 17 years old.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://fashion.telegraph.co.uk/news-features/TMG10664638/Miranda-Kerrs-mother-on-stepping-out-of-her-model-daughters-shadow.html|title=Miranda Kerr's mother on stepping out of her model daughter's 'shadow'|work=[[The Daily Telegraph]]|last=Lidbury|first=Olivia|date=27 February 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140312055631/http://fashion.telegraph.co.uk/news-features/TMG10664638/Miranda-Kerrs-mother-on-stepping-out-of-her-model-daughters-shadow.html|archive-date=12 March 2014}}</ref> She has a brother, Matthew, who is two years younger. Kerr is of English ancestry, with smaller amounts of Scottish and French.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.hellomagazine.com/profiles/miranda-kerr/|title=Miranda Kerr - Biography|work=[[Hello! (magazine)|Hello!]]|date=23 March 2010 }}</ref> During her childhood, Kerr "raced motorbikes and rode horses on her grandmother's farm". She describes her early life in the Australian countryside as "very grounding ... there wasn't any pretentiousness and no one really cared what you were wearing. You could just be you."<ref>{{cite web|last=Blake|first=Elissa|url=http://www.news.com.au/dailytelegraph/story/0,22049,22730119-5006011,00.html|title=Miranda's model life|work=[[Daily Telegraph (Sydney)|Daily Telegraph]]|date=11 November 2007|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071112024315/http://www.news.com.au/dailytelegraph/story/0%2C22049%2C22730119-5006011%2C00.html|archive-date=12 November 2007}}</ref> As a teenager, she was an exchange student in [[Virginia]], United States.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.vogue.com.au/celebrity/interviews/miranda-kerr-husband-evan-spiegel/news-story/1b886eba7046831e81d69de6159fd6b6|title=Miranda Kerr and Evan Spiegel give a Snap-shot of their Australian life|work=[[Vogue Australia]]|date=24 July 2022|last=Israel|first=Katrina}}</ref> Kerr is a [[Christians|Christian]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Weber |first=Catherine |date=2014-05-12 |title=Supermodel Miranda Kerr: 'I'm Christian, I Pray Every Day' |url=https://www.christianpost.com/news/supermodel-miranda-kerr-im-christian-i-pray-every-day.html |access-date=2026-04-10 |work=[[The Christian Post]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Walsh |first=Rachel Marie |date=2021-04-17 |title=Kora Organics CEO and supermodel Miranda Kerr on family, work and wellness |url=https://www.irishexaminer.com/lifestyle/fashionandbeauty/arid-40263620.html |access-date=2026-04-10 |website=Irish Examiner |language=en}}</ref>

Her family moved to [[Brisbane]], Queensland, to allow Kerr and her brother to experience city life. Kerr was initially reluctant to leave her childhood hometown, but her first boyfriend, Christopher Middlebrook, died in a car accident when they were teenagers and she said it was too painful to stay there.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.dailytelegraph.com.au/subscribe/news/1/?sourceCode=DTWEB_WRE170_a_GGL&dest=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.dailytelegraph.com.au%2Flifestyle%2Fstellar%2Five-accomplished-all-i-want-to-in-modelling-now-its-all-about-family%2Fnews-story%2F10c9041f05238d906b905d03502774e0&memtype=anonymous&mode=premium|url-access=registration|title=Kerr: 'I never took modelling very seriously'|work=The Daily Telegraph|date=September 25, 2016}}</ref> In 2000, she graduated from [[All Hallows' School]], a [[Catholic school|Catholic]] all-girls school in Brisbane, QLD. Kerr studied nutrition and [[health psychology]] before pursuing modelling.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.dailytelegraph.com.au/lifestyle/sunday-magazine/mirandas-kerr-ching-factor/story-e6frf039-1225784302273|title=Miranda's Kerr-Ching! factor|work=The Daily Telegraph|date=8 October 2012|last=Field|first=Melissa|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121109211939/http://www.dailytelegraph.com.au/lifestyle/sunday-magazine/mirandas-kerr-ching-factor/story-e6frf039-1225784302273|archive-date=9 November 2012}}</ref>

==Career==

===1997–2006: Career beginnings===
At age 13, Kerr entered and won the 1997 annual [[Dolly (magazine)|''Dolly'' magazine]]/Impulse model competition. She was flown to Sydney a week before her 14th birthday to shoot for the magazine. Upon Kerr's win, local media expressed "concerned outrage" at her young age. The controversy raised concerns about the glorification of young girls within the fashion, beauty, and entertainment industries.<ref>{{cite magazine|url= https://www.glamourmagazine.co.uk/gallery/miranda-kerr-model-style-fashion-evolution-best-outfits|title= Miranda Kerr's Style CV|magazine=Glamour UK|last=Lyons Powell|first=Hannah|date=26 May 2016|publisher=[[Condé Nast]] Britain}}</ref>

Some media outlets claimed her ''Dolly'' shoot (including images of a 14-year-old Kerr in bathing suits) constituted a form of [[paedophilia]]. Of the press, Kerr said: "In the media at the time they were trying to cling on to anything remotely to do with paedophilia. ''Dolly'' is a magazine for teenage girls, not for old men. And I was fully clothed! Doing a winter shoot! They just made something out of nothing."<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.smh.com.au/lifestyle/its-back-young-model-contest-that-caused-a-stir-for-kerr-20120709-21qp2.html|title=It's back: young model contest that caused a stir for Kerr|work=[[Sydney Morning Herald]]|last=Hornery|first=Andrew|date=9 July 2012}}</ref>

[[File:Miranda Kerr 2.jpg|thumb|left|Kerr in [[Perth]]]]
Kerr signed to Chic Management's Sydney division ({{circa}} 1997).<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.news.com.au/entertainment/celebrity-style/model-miranda-kerr-switches-from-chic-management-to-new-sydney-agency-img-models-and-signs-publicist-annie-kelly/news-story/4cfa7190319bd8867c9ff810bcda6655?sv=4498de95ee662ee0eb61a63161d87ab9|title=Miranda Kerr switches from Chic Management to new Sydney agency IMG Models|newspaper=[[News.com.au]]|date=20 July 2012|quote=...after 15 years at Chic.|last=Harris|first=Amy}}</ref> She received considerable commercial exposure after a series of beachwear ads predominantly for Australian surf chain [[Billabong (clothing)|Billabong]], in which Kerr modelled surf brands [[Jodhi Meares#Career|Tigerlily]], [[Roxy (clothing)|Roxy]], [[Billabong (clothing)|Billabong Girls]], and One Teaspoon.<ref name="BOF" /> Kerr was also the brand ambassador of Australia's most recognised swimwear brand, Seafolly.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://grazia.com.au/articles/face-of-seafolly-search-2017/|title=This Aussie swimwear brand is looking for the next Miranda, Shanina or Gigi|work=Grazia Australia|last=Sharp|first=Rachel}}</ref> After modelling in Australia and Japan,<ref name="MIRANDASMODELLIFE">{{cite web|url=http://www.news.com.au/dailytelegraph/story/0%2C22049%2C22730119-5006011%2C00.html|title=Miranda's Model Life|work=Daily Telegraph|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071211001041/http://www.news.com.au/dailytelegraph/story/0%2C22049%2C22730119-5006011%2C00.html|archive-date=11 December 2007|access-date=26 April 2008|last=Blake|first=Elissa}}</ref> Kerr relocated to [[New York City|New York]], where she acquired a minority stake in the [[Bowery Ballroom]], a music venue.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.glamourmagazine.co.uk/gallery/miranda-kerr-model-style-fashion-evolution-best-outfits|title=Miranda Kerr's Style CV|work=Glamour UK|date=26 May 2016}}</ref>

In New York, Kerr signed with [[Next Management]] and had a slew of runway appearances in early 2004.<ref name="BOF" /> From there, she was booked for runway and print campaigns for labels including [[Alex Perry]], [[Baby Phat]], [[Lisa Ho]], Voodoo Dolls, [[Levi's]], [[Bettina Liano]], [[Nicola Finetti]], [[L.A.M.B.]], [[Heatherette]], [[Betsey Johnson]], [[Trelise Cooper]], Jets, [[John Richmond (fashion designer)|John Richmond]], [[Blumarine]] Swimwear, [[Neiman Marcus]],  [[Anna Molinari]], [[Rock and Republic]], [[Roberto Cavalli]], and Ober Jeans.<ref name="BOF" /> Kerr was also booked for print in magazines such as ''[[Elle Girl]]'', ''[[Vogue Australia]]'' and ''[[Harper's Bazaar]]''.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fashionmodeldirectory.com/models/miranda_kerr/|title=Miranda Kerr|work=[[Fashion Model Directory]]}}</ref>

She signed a contract with American cosmetics brand [[Maybelline]].<ref name="BOF" /> Along with several other Victoria's Secret models, Kerr was also featured in a music video for the single "[[Number One (Pharrell song)|Number One]]" by [[Pharrell]] featuring [[Kanye West]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.usmagazine.com/food/pictures/kris-jenner-wines-down-after-a-busy-day-with-help-from-these-songs/number-one-2/|title=Kris Jenner 'Wines Down' After Busy Day With Help From Songs by Kanye West, Stevie Wonder and More|work=[[Us Weekly]]|date=11 September 2019|quote=This track from Pharrell Williams was released in 2006 and was cowritten by West. The music video for this tune featured models Selita Ebanks, Miranda Kerr and Rosie Huntington-Whiteley.}}</ref>

===2007–2012: Victoria's Secret and high fashion work===
[[File:MirandaKerrAug2011.jpg|thumb|Kerr at a book signing in 2011]]
Following her success with Maybelline, Kerr became the first ever Australian [[Victoria's Secret Angel]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.vogue.com.au/fashion/news/take-a-look-back-at-every-one-of-miranda-kerrs-iconic-victorias-secret-looks/image-gallery/df68035d28321cb81549cdc6ab99bc83|title=A look back at Miranda Kerr's most iconic Victoria's Secret runway moments|work=Vogue Australia|last=Xidias|first=Angelica|date=10 May 2018}}</ref> joining models [[Alessandra Ambrosio]], [[Karolína Kurková]], [[Adriana Lima]], [[Selita Ebanks]], [[Izabel Goulart]] and [[Heidi Klum]]. Before becoming an Angel in 2007, Kerr was already picked to become the successor of Alessandra Ambrosio as the face of [[Victoria's Secret#Pink|PINK]] in 2006.<ref name="BOF" />

In 2007, Kerr signed on as the face of Californian fashion retailer [[Arden B.]]<ref name="NYMag">{{cite web|url=http://nymag.com/fashion/models/mkerr/mirandakerr/|title=Miranda Kerr Model Profile|work=[[New York (magazine)|New York]]|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150317075303/http://nymag.com/fashion/models/mkerr/mirandakerr/|archive-date=17 March 2015}}</ref> Kerr made a small guest appearance in the [[CBS]] sitcom ''[[How I Met Your Mother]]'' alongside fellow Angels [[Adriana Lima]], [[Marisa Miller]], Alessandra Ambrosio, [[Heidi Klum]] and [[Selita Ebanks]].<ref>{{cite magazine|url=https://ew.com/article/2007/11/26/a-supermodel-to/|title=Hanging with (funny) supermodels on the 'How I Met Your Mother' set|magazine=[[Entertainment Weekly]]|last=Greenblatt|first=Leah|date=26 November 2007}}</ref>

In 2008, Kerr became the new face of the fragrance [[Clinique]] Happy and signed a six-figure deal to be the new face of Australian department store [[David Jones (department store)|David Jones]], replacing model [[Megan Gale]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.news.com.au/entertainment/story/0,26278,23482214-5007192,00.html|title=David Jones is Kerr's new darling|work=News.com.au|date=3 April 2008|access-date=26 April 2008|last=Byrnes|first=Holly|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080407191243/http://www.news.com.au/entertainment/story/0,26278,23482214-5007192,00.html|archive-date=7 April 2008}}</ref> She also appeared on the cover of British ''Harper's Bazaar''. Earning an estimated US$3.5 million over the previous 12 months, ''[[Forbes]]'' placed Kerr at No. 10 on the list of the world's top-earning models.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.forbes.com/2008/04/30/models-bundchen-klum-biz-media-cz_kb_0430topmodels_slide_20.html?thisSpeed=30000|title=World's Top Earning Models|work=[[Forbes]]|last=Blakely|first=Kiri|date=30 April 2008|access-date= 27 May 2008}}</ref>

In June 2009, Kerr posed naked, chained to a tree, for an issue of ''[[Rolling Stone]]'' Australia, to raise awareness for the endangered [[koalas]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.marieclaire.co.uk/news/celebrity-news/miranda-kerr-bares-all-for-koalas-191077|title=Miranda Kerr bares all for koalas|work=Marie Claire UK|last=Lubomirksi|first=Natalia|date=3 June 2009}}</ref> In October, Kerr launched her own brand of organic skincare products, [[KORA Organics]], with George Moskos, and became the face for the company.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.dailytelegraph.com.au/entertainment/sydney-confidential/beauty-product-ranges-from-stars-like-miranda-kerr-jessica-hart-and-lara-bingle-put-to-the-test/news-story/1a536d5a67529f1146f2e5c69d3fce67?nk=6e53fd149e0c018a6e051ed6095ffd5c-1570922320|title=Beauty product ranges from stars like Miranda Kerr, Jessica Hart and Lara Bingle put to the test|work=Daily Telegraph|date=June 14, 2015}}</ref> Kerr<!--sources seem to differ on what date it was. Some say 2010, others say 2012--> released an inspirational self-esteem, self-help book, ''Treasure Yourself''. The book is aimed at female teenagers.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.huffpost.com/entry/miranda-kerr-to-release-b_n_575693|title=Miranda Kerr To Release Book On Body Image (VIDEO, PHOTOS)|work=HuffPost|publisher=Verizon Media|date=13 May 2010}}</ref> Kerr also shot a spring/summer ad campaign for XOXO. Kerr appeared in ''Forbes'''s 2009 list of the world's highest-paid models, ranking at No. 9 with estimated earnings of $3 million.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.forbes.com/2009/05/27/moss-bundchen-klum-business-media-models_slide_19.html|title=The World's Top-Earning Models −9|work=Forbes|last=Streib|first=Lauren|date=May 27, 2009|access-date= 10 October 2011}}</ref> She left Next to sign with [[IMG Models]].<ref name="NYMag" />

[[File:Miranda Kerr (6796124945).jpg|thumb|Kerr at the AACTA Awards in Sydney, Australia in 2012]]Kerr appeared in the 2010 [[Pirelli Calendar]], photographed by [[Terry Richardson]] in [[Bahia, Brazil]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://nymag.com/daily/fashion/2009/06/terry_richardson_and_most_of_t.html|title=Terry Richardson and Most of the World's Models Gang Up for Pirelli Calendar 2010|work=[[New York (magazine)|New York]]|last=Bell|first=Gabriel|date=June 18, 2010|access-date=February 21, 2011}}</ref> Previously better known for her Victoria's Secret status rather than her [[high fashion]] work, [[Balenciaga]] is credited for launching her high fashion modelling career when casting directors [[Ashley Brokaw]] and designer [[Nicolas Ghesquière]] chose her to walk [[Runway (fashion)#Exclusive|exclusively]] for the brand's spring 2010 runway show.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://nymag.com/daily/fashion/2011/09/prada_or_balenciaga_who_carrie.html|title=Prada or Balenciaga: Who Carries More Weight in Modeling?|work=New York|date=September 26, 2010|access-date= 6 October 2011}}</ref> It was her first fashion show for a high fashion designer. A season later she walked for design company [[Prada]] for their fall 2010 collection in [[Milan Fashion Week|Milan]] alongside fellow Angels [[Doutzen Kroes]] and [[Alessandra Ambrosio]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.vogue.com/fashion-shows/fall-2010-ready-to-wear/prada|title=Fall 2010 Ready-to-wear Prada|work=Vogue|date=25 February 2010}}</ref> Kerr then modelled for campaigns for Prada and [[Jil Sander]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.thecut.com/2010/05/miranda_kerr_landed_a_jil_sand.html|title=Miranda Kerr Landed a Jil Sander Campaign|work=The Cut|date=21 May 2010 |publisher=[[New York (magazine)|New York]]}}</ref> and was shot by [[Steven Meisel]] for the cover of ''[[Vogue Italia]]'' for the September issue.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.vogue.it/en/fashion/cover-fashion-stories/2010/08/28/vision-of-femininity/|title=Vision of Femininity|work=[[Vogue Italia]]|date=28 August 2010}}</ref>

In January 2011, Kerr became the first pregnant model for ''Vogue'' when featured in ''[[Vogue Australia]]'', being six months pregnant at the time of the shoot.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.novafm.com.au/article_miranda-kerr-is-vogue-s-first-pregnant-cover-model_105689|title= Miranda Kerr is Vogue's first pregnant cover model|work=NovaFM|access-date=28 October 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110113111233/http://www.novafm.com.au/article_miranda-kerr-is-vogue-s-first-pregnant-cover-model_105689 |archive-date=13 January 2011}}</ref> In March she hit the catwalk for Balenciaga's fall 2011 [[ready-to-wear]] collection as part of [[Paris Fashion Week]], two months after giving birth. Kerr also posed nude for a 2011 ''[[Harper's Bazaar]]'' photo shoot.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.perthnow.com.au/news/wa/miranda-kerr-nude-pic-in-harpers-bazaar-shows-her-post-baby-career-is-shaping-up-gorgeously-ng-f319b2848279f96cf37c6284f6e14b13|title=Miranda Kerr nude pic in Harper's Bazaar shows her post-baby career is shaping up gorgeously|work=[[PerthNow]]|date=8 October 2011|access-date=10 October 2011}}</ref> In October at Paris Fashion Week S/S12, Kerr walked for [[Dior]], [[Lanvin (company)|Lanvin]], [[Chanel]], [[John Galliano]], [[Stella McCartney]], [[Viktor & Rolf]] and [[Loewe (fashion brand)|Loewe]]. Kerr was chosen to present the $2.5 million ''[[Victoria's Secret Fantasy Bra|Victoria's Secret Fantasy Treasure Bra]]'' for their fashion show in November 2011.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.glamour.com/story/victorias-secret-diamond-bras-lily-aldridge|title=Every Victoria's Secret Angel Who Has Worn the Fantasy Bra|work=Glamour|last=Rosa|first=Christopher|date=2 November 2015}}</ref> Kerr then featured in the Spring 2012 campaign for [[Bally Shoe|Bally]] alongside German model [[Julia Stegner]].<ref>{{cite magazine|title=Miranda Kerr & Julia Stegner's Bally Campaign|url=https://www.thecut.com/2011/11/new-bally-ad-features-goats-miranda-kerr.html|magazine=The Cut|access-date=18 December 2020|date=28 November 2011|last=Cowles|first=Charlotte}}</ref>

In January 2012, she was named ambassador for [[Qantas]]. In March, Kerr walked for Chanel and [[Miu Miu]] at Fall/Winter Paris Fashion Week.<ref>{{cite web|last=Byrne|first=Fiona|date=13 January 2012|url=http://www.news.com.au/travel/news/miranda-kerr-named-new-qantas-ambassador/story-e6frfq80-1226243457311|title=Does model Miranda Kerr have what it takes to get Qantas soaring again?|website= News.com.au|access-date=3 August 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120229144650/https://www.news.com.au/travel/news/miranda-kerr-named-new-qantas-ambassador/story-e6frfq80-1226243457311|archive-date=February 29, 2012}}</ref> Kerr was featured on the June cover of ''[[Numéro]]'' Tokyo, shot by [[Nino Muñoz]]. In August, Kerr appeared on the cover of ''Vogue'' Turkey and in November, was named the new face of high street brand [[Mango (clothing)|Mango]], replacing [[Kate Moss]] for its spring/summer 2013 campaign.<ref>{{cite web|title=Miranda Kerr's Vogue Turkey Cover Is Rather Odd|url=http://www.huffingtonpost.com/2012/07/26/miranda-kerr-vogue-turkey_n_1705261.html|website=[[HuffPost]]|access-date=13 August 2015|date=26 July 2012}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Miranda Kerr is the new face of MANGO|url=https://www.elle.com/uk/fashion/news/a4944/miranda-kerr-is-the-new-face-of-mango/|publisher=Elle|date=22 November 2012}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.marieclaire.co.uk/news/celebrity-news/miranda-kerr-announced-as-face-of-mango-s-spring-summer-2013-campaign-135357|title=Miranda Kerr replaces Kate Moss as face of Mango|website=[[Marie Claire]]|date=November 22, 2012}}</ref>

===2013–present: Continued success===
[[File:Miranda Kerr (8449761941) 2013-02-06.jpg|thumb|Kerr in 2013]]
In March 2013, negotiations to renew her five-year contract with David Jones "fell through," leading to a peaceful split between the two parties.<ref>{{cite news|last=Krupnick|first=Ellie|title=Miranda Kerr 'Breaks Up' With David Jones, Replaced By Jessica Gomes & Montana Cox|url=http://www.huffingtonpost.com/2013/03/22/miranda-kerr-breaks-up-david-jones_n_2931516.html|work=Huffington Post|access-date=14 April 2013|date=22 March 2013}}</ref> The following month, it was reported that Kerr's three-year, US$1-million contract with Victoria's Secret was not being renewed. Anonymous sources claimed Kerr had a "difficult reputation" and was not "a big seller for VS"; however, Kerr's camp stated she was unable to commit the necessary time to the brand. In response, Victoria's Secret chief marketing officer [[Ed Razek]] stated he had already invited Kerr to walk in that year's fashion show.<ref>{{cite news|title=Miranda Kerr Reportedly Dropped As VS Angel; Kate Upton and Diddy May Be Dating|url=http://www.thedailybeast.com/articles/2013/04/10/miranda-kerr-reportedly-dropped-as-vs-angel-kate-upton-and-diddy-may-be-dating.html|work=[[The Daily Beast]]|date=10 April 2013|access-date=14 April 2013}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Miranda Kerr leaving Victoria's Secret, 3 months/year too big a commitment |url=https://www.foxnews.com/entertainment/miranda-kerr-leaving-victorias-secret-3-months-year-too-big-a-commitment|publisher=[[New York Post]]|access-date=26 January 2026|date=11 April 2013|via=Fox News Channel}}</ref> Kerr headlined the April issue of ''Vogue'' Australia and the July issue of ''Vogue'' Korea.<ref>{{cite web|title=Miranda Kerr Covers Vogue Korea For The July 2013 Issue (PHOTOS)|url=http://www.huffingtonpost.com/2013/06/14/miranda-kerr-covers-vogue_n_3441178.html|website=Huffington Post|access-date=16 August 2015|date=14 July 2013}}</ref>

She was ranked No. 2 in ''Forbes'' 2013 list of the world's highest-paid models, with estimated earnings of $7.2 million, which is $3.2 million more and a jump of five places in the list from the previous year.<ref>{{cite magazine|last=Le|first=Vanna|title=The World's Highest-Paid Models, 2013: Gisele's Earnings Down, Kerr's Are Up|url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/vannale/2013/08/19/the-worlds-highest-paid-models-of-2013/|magazine=Forbes.com|access-date=31 October 2013|date=19 August 2013}}</ref> In October, Kerr was named the face of Austrian crystal house [[Swarovski]] for their fall 2013 campaign, and that December she starred in social shopping website ShopStyle's first national campaign.<ref>{{cite web|last=Hamilton|first=Carmen|title=Behind the scenes on Miranda Kerr's next major campaign|url=http://www.vogue.com.au/fashion/accessories/galleries/behind+the+scenes+on+miranda+kerrs+next+major+campaign,26811|publisher=Vogue Australia|date=4 October 2013|access-date=31 October 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131007010538/https://www.vogue.com.au/fashion/accessories/galleries/behind+the+scenes+on+miranda+kerrs+next+major+campaign,26811|archive-date=7 October 2013}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last=Sugar|first=Lisa|title=Miranda Kerr Is the New Face of ShopStyle|date=12 December 2013|url=http://www.popsugar.com/Miranda-Kerr-ShopStyle-Ad-Photos-32633093|publisher=[[PopSugar]]|access-date=28 March 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140122185404/http://www.popsugar.com/Miranda-Kerr-ShopStyle-Ad-Photos-32633093|archive-date=22 January 2014}}</ref>

In February 2014, Kerr became the face of Swedish clothing brand [[H&M]]. She then featured in high-profile campaigns for [[Reebok]] and [[Wonderbra]]. In March, Kerr opened and closed for [[Sonia Rykiel]] at Fall/Winter Paris Fashion Week. On 22 April 2014, Kerr released her first single online, featuring her and crooner Bobby Fox, in a cover of [[Elvis Presley]]'s "You're The Boss".<ref>{{cite magazine |title=Miranda Kerr Sings on From 2003 to mid-2007, Kerr dated [[Jay Lyon]], the lead singer of the band Tamarama. Kerr starred in Tamarama's video clip for "Everything To Me".<ref>{{cite web|last=Moran|first=Jonathon|date=11 November 2007|url=http://www.adelaidenow.com.au/entertainment/confidential/kerr-single-but-love-blooms/story-e6fredq3-1111114851843|title=Miranda Kerr single but love may Bloom|work=The Daily Telegraph via Advertiser|access-date=1 September 2010|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120201073111/http://www.adelaidenow.com.au/entertainment/confidential/kerr-single-but-love-blooms/story-e6fredq3-1111114851843|archive-date=1 February 2012}}</ref>

Kerr began dating English actor [[Orlando Bloom]] in late 2007.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://people.com/celebrity/orlando-bloom-meets-miranda-kerrs-parents/|title=Orlando Bloom Meets Miranda Kerr's Parents|date=28 April 2008|work=People|access-date=27 September 2013|publisher=Meredith Corporation}}</ref> In 2009, a gang of thieves known as the [[Bling Ring]] broke into Bloom's home. ===Religious views===
In response to claims that she was a practising [[Buddhism|Buddhist]], she told ''[[The Daily Telegraph]]'' that she was a Christian: <blockquote>"I'm not Buddhist. I'm Christian. I pray every day. I meditate every day and I do yoga. I'm not religious, I'm spiritual. And praying is something my grandmother taught me as well. To pray and be grateful, have gratitude, is a big thing for me."<ref>{{cite web|last1=Grose|first1=Jessica|title=Miranda Kerr: everyone's cup of tea?|url=http://fashion.telegraph.co.uk/news-features/TMG10811028/Miranda-Kerr-everyones-cup-of-tea.html|website=The Telegraph|access-date=22 August 2014}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.foxnews.com/entertainment/miranda-kerr-im-christian-and-i-pray-every-day/|title=Miranda Kerr: 'I'm Christian' and 'I pray every day'|date=12 May 2014|publisher=[[Fox News]]|access-date=21 August 2014}}</ref></blockquote>She later told ''Into The Gloss'':<ref>{{cite web|title=Miranda Kerr's 7 Rules For Adulthood|url=http://intothegloss.com/2014/08/miranda-kerr-interview/|website=Into The Gloss|access-date=22 August 2014}}</ref>

<blockquote>I like to pray and I like to meditate. Doing just three minutes of prayer and a minimum of five minutes meditation twice a day sets the tone—like an arrow so that you're hitting your target. When I pray I always thank Mother Nature for all the beauty in the world; it's about having an attitude of gratitude. And then I pray to Christ to say, 'Thank you for this day and my family and my health,' and now that I'm older I've added, 'Please illuminate me. Please open my heart chakra. Open my aperture and uplift my consciousness so that I can be the best version of myself.'</blockquote>

She says her religious faith, including practices like forgiveness, prayer, meditation, and speaking with friends, helped her deal with challenges such as the death of her then-boyfriend at age 15, and "makes it a priority to pray about forgiving herself and others."<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.christianpost.com/news/supermodel-miranda-kerr-says-prayer-gratitude-forgiveness-are-daily-rules-she-lives-by-125046/|title=Supermodel Miranda Kerr Says Prayer, Gratitude, Forgiveness Are Daily Rules She Lives By|last=Martinez|first=Jessica|date=19 August 2014|newspaper=[[The Christian Post]]|access-date=21 August 2014|quote=The Australian model says she is Christian despite previous reports that she is a practicing Buddhist and believes in the power of forgiveness even in the "little things like looking at someone the wrong way, or snapping at someone." She also notes that she makes it a priority to pray about forgiving herself and others because when she does, it creates an "energy shift" in her life. "Even those that we find challenging to be around are sometimes the people that need the prayers the most," said Kerr. "If you've had an intense conversation with someone, a good thing to do would be to say to them, 'I forgive you, and please forgive me.' We all say things sometimes to hurt people, so it's important to forgive and have peace …"}}</ref>

extract:
Miranda May Kerr (; born 20 April 1983) is an Australian model. She rose to prominence in 2007 as one of the Victoria's Secret Angels. Kerr was the first Australian Victoria's Secret model and also represented the Australian department store chain David Jones. She has launched her own brand of organic skincare products, KORA Organics, and has written a self-help book.
Kerr began modelling in the fashion industry when she was only 13, winning the 1997 Dolly magazine model search competition. Since 2008, she has consistently ranked on the Forbes list of highest earning models. She was previously married to English actor Orlando Bloom, with whom she had her first son. Since 2017, she has been married to Snapchat CEO Evan Spiegel, with whom she has three children.
